history:
BIM Earth Consultancy, where innovation, precision, and collaboration come together to transform the Architecture, Engineering, and Construction (AEC) industry. We specialize in delivering high-quality Building Information Modeling (BIM) solutions that help clients design, construct, and manage projects more efficiently. BIM Earth Consultancy (BEC) was established in 2021 to serve the needs of AEC and Design/ build industry. With years of practice and experience in Building information modelling, BEC offers BIM services covering 3D BIM modelling, Clash detection, 4D scheduling and simulation, 5D cost estimation services and Facilities & Assets Information Management.

At BIM Earth Consultancy, we believe that every successful project starts with accurate information and intelligent planning. Our team combines technical expertise with industry best practices to provide BIM services that improve coordination, reduce project risks, and optimize construction workflows. Today, we serve premium developers, government agencies, and corporate clients globally as a trusted multi-disciplinary consultancy, driving cost reductions of up to 18% and shortening design cycles by 30%.
vision: “To be a trusted and innovative BIM consultancy, transforming the Architecture, Engineering and Construction (AEC) industry through intelligent digital solutions, technical excellence, and collaborative project delivery.” At BIM Earth Consultancy, our vision is to contribute to a smarter and more digitally connected construction industry where technology, information, and expertise come together to create better-built environments.
mission: At BIM Earth Consultancy, our mission is to deliver innovative, accurate, and reliable Building Information Modelling (BIM) solutions that help our clients achieve better project outcomes throughout the design, construction, and operational stages of the built environment. We are committed to combining technical expertise, advanced digital technologies, industry best practices, and collaborative workflows to provide efficient BIM solutions tailored to the unique requirements of every project.
integrity: At BIM Earth Consultancy, integrity is at the heart of everything we do. We believe that successful business relationships are built on trust, transparency, accountability, and professional responsibility.

milestones.title: Building the Foundation
milestones.description: BIM Earth Consultancy began its journey with a clear vision: to provide reliable and innovative BIM solutions that improve the way construction projects are planned, designed, coordinated, and delivered. We established our core BIM capabilities and began building a strong foundation in 3D modelling, design coordination, documentation, and digital construction workflows.

milestones.title: Growing Through Experience
milestones.description: In 2022, we expanded our technical capabilities and strengthened our project delivery processes. Our team worked on multiple BIM assignments, gaining valuable experience across different project requirements and disciplines. Our focus expanded to include architectural, structural, and MEP modelling, along with multidisciplinary coordination and model-based project support.

milestones.title: Turning Expertise into Results
milestones.description: With growing experience, BIM Earth Consultancy successfully contributed to multiple projects and developed a stronger understanding of complex BIM workflows. We focused on delivering accurate models, coordinated designs, clash identification, detailed documentation, and efficient project collaboration, helping project stakeholders make better-informed decisions.

milestones.title: Building Trust Through Quality
milestones.description: By 2024, BIM Earth Consultancy had strengthened its project execution capabilities and continued to support clients with professional BIM services. Our experience across multiple projects enabled us to improve our quality control, coordination processes, modelling standards, and project management approach while maintaining a strong commitment to accuracy and timely delivery.

milestones.title: Advancing with Technology
milestones.description: In 2025, we continued to evolve with the changing needs of the AEC industry. We embraced improved digital workflows and advanced BIM practices to deliver more efficient and coordinated project solutions. Our growing portfolio of projects reflects our ability to adapt to different project scales, disciplines, standards, and client requirements.

milestones.title: Creating the Future of Digital Construction
milestones.description: Today, BIM Earth Consultancy continues to grow as a BIM-focused consultancy, working toward delivering smarter, more coordinated, and technology-driven solutions for the built environment. Our journey is not just measured by the number of projects we have completed, but by the knowledge we have gained, relationships we have built, and value we have delivered through every project. We look forward to expanding our capabilities, embracing emerging technologies, and creating new possibilities through Building Information Modelling.
